city.name: {city}
city.summary: A busy port city of several hundred thousand people where hybrids and humans share the streets and most city offices are run by women.

institutions.name: {city} Police Department
institutions.title: Officer
institutions.tone: Procedural and cautious; asks for names and papers and answers very little.

institutions.name: Federal Office of Anomalous Events
institutions.title: Agent
institutions.tone: Courteous and controlled; never explains who sent them and never raises a voice.

protocol.cue: Sirens wail somewhere beyond the walls, drawing closer.
protocol.want: {name} came to check a report of something falling from the sky and to find out who is hurt.

protocol.cue: A dark vehicle idles outside, engine low, no siren.
protocol.want: {name} came because instruments logged an Ether discharge and wants to speak with whoever caused it.

protocol.cue: Boots and radios outside: someone is going door to door.
protocol.want: {name} is searching the area for the person from the report, who has not been found.

protocol.cue: A second, quieter knock follows the first visit.
protocol.want: {name} came to follow up on a person with no papers and no record who dropped from the sky.
